name: test-failure-summarizer
purpose: Run or parse test, lint, and typecheck output and return actionable failures only.
use_when: Raw command output is too noisy for direct LLM inspection
avoid_when: The failure output is already short and specific
The task is to design tests rather than inspect failures

inputs.log_path: Optional path to an existing test, lint, typecheck, or CI log.

outputs.failures: List of actionable failures with file, line, message, and likely area when available.

notes: Planned tool. Until implemented, run focused tests and summarize only failing lines and relevant tracebacks.
